Title: Reach every data-model settings page from Admin Settings
Clarification Ref: Confirmed behaviors: in-scope pages
Preconditions: Logged in as account owner/admin (Rakesh M). Admin Settings home open.
Steps: 1) Click side group 'Leads, Contacts, & Accounts'. 2) Confirm 9 tiles are listed. 3) Click each tile in turn: Contacts, Accounts, Custom Modules, Contact Lifecycle Stages, Contact Scoring, Web Forms, CRM Code Library, LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms; return to settings home between tiles. 4) Do NOT follow tile 'Website Embed Code' (leaves module).
Expected Result: Each page loads at its URL (contacts/forms, sales_accounts/forms, module-customization, lifecycle_stages, predictive_scoring, integrations/webform/classic, integrations/freshsales-web, linkedin-lead-capture). Baseline console errors (3) and warnings (9) are ignored.
